purpose: Fast causal Stage-A screen of session/liquidity-reversal entries after raw structural breakout families showed abundant supply but negative immediate persistence.

source_basis.disclosed_logic: Build and lock Asian-session high/low, then during London require price to trade beyond a locked level and close back on the original side; enter in reversal direction.
source_basis.project_fixture_disclosure: Use WarRoom explicit GMT windows: Asia 00:00-06:00, London killzone 07:00-10:00. One first qualifying sweep per side/day. Closed-bar only.

source_basis.disclosed_logic: XAUUSD M5/M15: after Asian range closes, price must trade beyond Asian high/low by at least 5% of the range and close back inside; reversal entry at reclaim close.
source_basis.project_fixture_disclosure: Use WarRoom explicit Asia 00:00-06:00 GMT and London killzone 07:00-10:00 GMT so session boundaries are deterministic. ADR/news/trend overlays from source are intentionally excluded for this minimal entry-quality screen.

17CW_ASIA_LONDON_SWEEP_M5.rule: first completed London-killzone bar whose high > locked Asia high and close < Asia high => SHORT; low < Asia low and close > Asia low => LONG; one first event per side/day

17CX_ASIA_LONDON_SWEEP_M15.rule: same strict wick-through and close-back-inside grammar

17CY_XAUGOLD_SWEEP5_M5.rule: same reclaim, but wick must extend beyond locked Asia boundary by >=5% of Asia range

gate.selection_rule: Advance any unchanged lane meeting activity gates and nonnegative direct net immediately to independent later-January validation; retire failures without rescue.
